title: LLM Prompt Trace Schema
description: Schema for recording LLM prompt/response traces in OBLIVION.

prompt_id.description: Unique identifier for this LLM interaction

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the prompt was sent

tier.description: Obfuscation tier applied to this function

prompt.description: Full prompt text sent to the LLM

response.description: Raw text response returned by the LLM

parsed_ok.description: Whether the response was successfully parsed and schema-valid

error.description: Optional error message if parsing or validation failed
